scripts.dev: concurrently -n core,store -c blue,magenta "bun --cwd core dev" "bun --cwd store dev"
scripts.precommit: bun run format:staged && bun run precommit:check
scripts.precommit:check: bun --cwd core lint && bun --cwd core lint:types && bun --cwd store lint && ./node_modules/.bin/tsc -p packages/sdk/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.lint: bun run lint:core && bun run lint:repo
scripts.lint:core: bun --cwd core lint && bun --cwd core lint:types
scripts.test: set -a && { [ ! -f .env ] || . ./.env; } && set +a && bun run test:bun && bun run test:vitest
scripts.test:full: set -a && { [ ! -f .env ] || . ./.env; } && set +a && bun run test:bun && bun run test:vitest
scripts.test:bun: set -a && { [ ! -f .env ] || . ./.env; } && set +a && bun test --parallel=1 --timeout=15000 tests/unit tests/integration/routes tests/integration/runtime tests/integration/server tests/integration/store tests/integration/plugins tests/integration/analytics tests/perf tests/security
scripts.test:vitest: set -a && { [ ! -f .env ] || . ./.env; } && set +a && NODE_ENV=test vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:assistant:live: bun run test:assistant:live:openai && bun run test:assistant:live:openrouter && bun run test:assistant:live:cms:openai && bun run test:assistant:live:cms:openrouter
scripts.test:assistant:live:cms:openai: set -a && { [ ! -f .env ] || . ./.env; } && set +a && TEST_OPENROUTER_API_KEY= TEST_OPENROUTER_MODEL= bun test tests/integration/assistant-live
scripts.test:assistant:live:cms:openrouter: set -a && { [ ! -f .env ] || . ./.env; } && set +a && TEST_OPENAI_API_KEY= TEST_OPENAI_MODEL= bun test tests/integration/assistant-live
scripts.test:coverage:all: bun run test:coverage && bun run test:coverage:bun
scripts.test:unit: bun run test:unit:bun && bun run test:unit:vitest
scripts.test:integration: bun test tests/integration/routes tests/integration/runtime tests/integration/server tests/integration/store tests/integration/plugins tests/integration/analytics
scripts.scan:trivy: bun run scan:trivy:vuln && bun run scan:trivy:config && bun run scan:trivy:secret
scripts.scan:trivy:strict: bun run scan:trivy:vuln:strict && bun run scan:trivy:config:strict && bun run scan:trivy:secret:strict
scripts.scan:trivy:vuln: trivy fs --scanners vuln --exit-code 0 --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --ignore-unfixed --include-dev-deps --skip-dirs _docs --skip-dirs node_modules --skip-dirs dist --skip-dirs build --skip-dirs .next --skip-dirs .git .
scripts.scan:trivy:vuln:strict: trivy fs --scanners vuln --exit-code 1 --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --ignore-unfixed --include-dev-deps --skip-dirs _docs --skip-dirs node_modules --skip-dirs dist --skip-dirs build --skip-dirs .next --skip-dirs .git .
scripts.scan:trivy:config: trivy config --exit-code 0 --severity MEDIUM,HIGH,CRITICAL --skip-dirs _docs --skip-dirs node_modules --skip-dirs dist --skip-dirs build --skip-dirs .next .
scripts.scan:trivy:config:strict: trivy config --exit-code 1 --severity MEDIUM,HIGH,CRITICAL --skip-dirs _docs --skip-dirs node_modules --skip-dirs dist --skip-dirs build --skip-dirs .next .
scripts.scan:trivy:secret: trivy fs --scanners secret --exit-code 0 --skip-dirs _docs --skip-dirs node_modules --skip-dirs dist --skip-dirs build --skip-dirs .next --skip-dirs .git .
scripts.scan:trivy:secret:strict: trivy fs --scanners secret --exit-code 1 --skip-dirs _docs --skip-dirs node_modules --skip-dirs dist --skip-dirs build --skip-dirs .next --skip-dirs .git .
scripts.scan:gitleaks: bun run scan:gitleaks:history && bun run scan:gitleaks:worktree
scripts.scan:gitleaks:strict: bun run scan:gitleaks:history:strict && bun run scan:gitleaks:worktree:strict
scripts.scan:sbom: mkdir -p .tmp && trivy fs --scanners vuln --format cyclonedx --output .tmp/security-sbom.cdx.json --skip-dirs _docs --skip-dirs node_modules --skip-dirs dist --skip-dirs build --skip-dirs .next --skip-dirs .git .
scripts.db:generate: set -a; [ ! -f .env ] || . ./.env; set +a; bunx drizzle-kit generate --config core/db/drizzle.config.ts
scripts.db:migrate: set -a; [ ! -f .env ] || . ./.env; set +a; bunx drizzle-kit migrate --config core/db/drizzle.config.ts
